label: Projection of the classical GOD_4 root onto the box K node of the fork route
summary: Issue #1926 phase 0. QUESTION (narrowed 2026-11-24 after independent review): can the box K node cdf897a8 (NecessaryRootBoxK) of the cheapest root route 8df2faad be derived from the quarta-via classical GOD_4 root da3facd6 (NecessaryClassicalGodRootAt), with a verified theorem and a strength order? Whether that re-routes the fork route off the bare leaf b9816722 (RootFactsForBearer, which unfolds to RootFacts = ActualRoot and IsGod and IsTheOneGod and HasClassicalAttributes, that is, the existence and attributes of GOD_4 as one leaf) is the separate, blocked attempt 'Re-routing the fork route's box K node off the packed GOD_4 leaf' (b3467390). TYPE CHECK: no mismatch. Both declarations take the same Signature sigma, the same Profile m on sigma.Being and the same world w. The necessity clause of da3facd6 is NecessaryAt m.ontic w n (inside PerfectRootAt), and BoxExistsAt m.ontic w n is the same proposition over the same frame m.ontic.frame (necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt, Iff.rfl). ActualRoot is the same NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot in both; IsTheOneGod sigma.IsGod is the fourth of the nine case predicates; HasClassicalAttributes is the same signature field. The relation CN of the box K node is unused by that sense. Both nodes carry the single sense NECESSARY_2 and GOD_4 (truth semantics preflight: no unbridged mixing). RESULT: verified zero-axiom theorem NecessaryClassicalGodRootBoxK.boxKOfClassicalGodRoot (result f4395e76), registered as strengthens da3facd6 to cdf897a8 (relation 0ebd1a3c). The proof only destructures the hypothesis and rebuilds the conclusion, so it is declared an assembly (transcription kind assembly), exactly like the sibling projections 822de823 and 0e932825 from the same node. STRICTNESS: a non-degenerate two-point separator (result 4e83dbac). Both candidates are actual roots and only one is GOD_4. No supplied predicate is emptied so that an attribute fails; in the main model six relations (InPotency, MoreIn, PriorSimply, ComponentOf, Composite, MatterForm) are empty, so immutability, maximum, firstness, remoteness, simplicity and matter/form exclusion hold vacuously at both candidates, and CausesIn is total. The box K node holds with the GOD_4 candidate as witness; the classical root fails; on that model the classical root is equivalent to some candidate satisfying every other conjunct of its body and being the only actual root, the GOD_4 candidate satisfies every other conjunct, and the other candidate is a second actual root that is not GOD_4. So only the selected-root uniqueness conjunct of PerfectRootAt fails; the box K node's IsTheOneGod is uniqueness among GOD_4 bearers only. A restored-relation control on the same signature and Profile (non-empty MoreIn, PriorSimply and CausesIn from the GOD_4 candidate to the other; potency, composition and matter/form only at the other; ComponentOf still empty) gives the same failure through uniqueness alone, with the rest of the body at the GOD_4 candidate and maximum and firstness failing at the other, so the separation does not rest on the vacuous clauses. The first draft separator failed only by emptying HasIntellect, a free parameter the box K node does not mention, and was replaced. The other content the classical root adds (maximum, perfection, firstness, esse/essence identity, matter/form exclusion, remoteness, eight case predicates) is a syntactic difference only; no model here separates on it. No certified difference (strength_comparison, #1598) is registered: the sense-fork precedents factor through a witness-independent frame condition, while here the added content constrains the witness of an existential, so a delta needs a new same-witness delta statement and its equivalence proof (not attempted). COMPUTED EFFECT: none on route costs or closure. truth frontier --json on the merged head (main 62bb4ce3c plus this batch) gives da3facd6, cdf897a8 and bed94ec2 the status proved: each is closed by rule (a), proved from open premises, and none is established. cdf897a8 was already closed by rule (a) through 0b9f4b1c and a693bf86, so rule (d) through this assembly adds no closure. An assembly never expands a statement in the route-cost diagnostic and is not a support bundle, so the fork route still expands cdf897a8 through 0b9f4b1c with b9816722, and its cost 16 is unchanged. FINDING 1 (route listing for cdf897a8): truth frontier --routes --frontier-root cdf897a8-5490-561a-b9d2-507486a3f192 lists 25bfe291 cost 1 [cheapest, transcription] (an assembly from the actualist K node 7f24ce4d; as a transcription it expands nothing under the --routes rule of docs/corpus-model.md), the packed bundle 0b9f4b1c cost 4 (leaves e068a626, 48366fb2, ab83e6d3, b9816722), the naming-node bundle 25135d6e cost 6 (its premise 8540b456 is derived only from cdf897a8 itself, by eceaaacc, so the bundle runs back through the packed bundle; without 0b9f4b1c it costs 45), the new projection e3d120ed cost 35 [transcription] (the cheapest derivation of da3facd6, 379399d1, costs 35) and the unpacked bundle a693bf86 cost 43, from the same 25 quarta-via premises as the da3facd6 derivation 3a56507d. The route-cost rule expands cdf897a8 through the verified non-transcription proof with the smallest leaf union (greedy), which is 0b9f4b1c. FINDING 2 (size of the packing artifact, counterfactual diagnostic only): on a scratch copy of the merged head (main 62bb4ce3c plus this batch) with argument 0b9f4b1c and its result 8348fe91 removed, the fork route 8df2faad costs 55 (22 bare, 6 supported, 27 proved), and the cheapest route becomes 88671579 (from GOD_4 exists, cost 26). So the cost 16 is reached because one bare leaf, b9816722, stands for the whole support of the existence and attributes of GOD_4. This is a diagnostic comparison, not a cost reduction or a judgment about b9816722; b9816722 is a legitimate direct-assumption option and stays recorded as such. FINDING 3 (modal premises idle at the root step): catholicismFromIntendedReading (Results/Causality/NecessarySenseFork/Solution.lean) destructures the fork node bed94ec2 and uses only the witness g, IsGod g, IsTheOneGod and HasClassicalAttributes. The sense choice, its uniqueness, NecessaryIn and ActualRoot are discarded. So the five modal leaves of the route (T schema cb456382, IntendedIsBoxT 0aa36cd6, TheoryOnCone 48366fb2, ExistenceDictionary ab83e6d3, the stated-theory consequence e068a626) are needed to prove the fork node but carry no content into the root conclusion; the God content enters only through b9816722. Nothing was deleted. NEXT TEST: a computed view of premises that pack conjuncts of their argument's conclusion, and of premises whose content the root step discards (issue #1926 phase 4). Optional: a certified difference for the new registration with a same-witness delta statement (#1598). Note: docs/notes/cheapest-route-packing.md.
